_source: Levine ME et al. An epigenetic biomarker of aging for lifespan and healthspan. Aging (Albany NY). 2018;10(4):573-591. PMID 29676998.
_note: Coefficients from Table S1 / Methods. PhenoAge = linear combination of 9 biomarkers + age, then transformed via Gompertz mortality model.

gompertz_parameters.comment: Gompertz mortality rate parameter. PhenoAge derived from: mortality_score = 1 - exp(-exp(xb) * (exp(gamma*120) - 1) / gamma), then PhenoAge = ln(-ln(1 - mortality_score) / gamma) / gamma

published_validation.comment: Pearson r between PhenoAge and chronological age in NHANES III (Table 1, Levine 2018)
